text: dsh-CommandCode-meter 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话费用与订阅额度插件。它监听模型调用用量并按价格目录记入本地账本，在设置页面和侧边栏显示费用、预算及额度信息。用户可以查看会话和历史费用、同步官方模型价格，并按需查询 Command Code 订阅的 5 小时、每周和月度额度。适合希望在 DSH 中了解模型调用花费和订阅余量的用户。Command Code 额度查询需要配置 COMMANDCODE_API_KEY；其他统计基于本地用量账本。

dsh-CommandCode-meter tracks model costs and subscription quotas in the DSH web client. It records usage locally and shows costs in settings and the sidebar. Users can review history, sync prices, and query Command Code quota windows. Quota lookup requires COMMANDCODE_API_KEY.

I want to track model usage costs and subscription quota from the DSH web interface.
dsh-CommandCode-meter 的功能「会话费用统计」：监听 DSH 模型流中的用量数据并按模型记入费用账本，供界面查看会话和历史费用。
dsh-CommandCode-meter 的功能「Command Code 额度查看」：在启用额度查询并配置凭证后，请求官方额度接口，显示滚动 5 小时、每周和月度额度用量。
dsh-CommandCode-meter 使用前须知：查询 Command Code 额度时，COMMANDCODE_API_KEY 作为 Bearer 凭证发送至 api.commandcode.ai。
dsh-CommandCode-meter 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 10 天；提交数 5；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-CommandCode-meter README · 源仓库与致谢：本插件是 [dsh-cost-meter](https://github.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter) 的定制 fork。上游 `dsh-cost-meter` 是一个功能完整的 **DeepSeek Harness 会话费用统计插件**:提供本会话费用、官方余额查询、预算图框、自定义 Provider 余额、历史记录、峰谷计价、官方价格同步、Coding Plan 额度、Token 热图等功能,内置 90+ 模型价格目录与自动匹配,界面中英双语,由 [Han-1413141](https://github.com/Han-1413141) 以 [MIT](LICENSE) 许可开源维护。

dsh-CommandCode-meter README · 源仓库与致谢：**改动原因**:我们日常使用 **Command Code GOAT** 订阅(而非 OpenCode Go)。上游插件的 Go 额度卡只对接 `opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`,无法查询 Command Code 的订阅额度。因此 fork 本仓库,将 Go 额度卡整体替换为 Command Code 官方接口 `GET https://api.commandcode.ai/alpha/billing/credits`(Bearer 认证),并补充 5 小时 / 本周 / 月度池三档「已用 / 全部 + 进度条」展示;凭据解析也改为 DSH 凭据库 / 环境变量 `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY`。除 Go 额度卡相关代码外,其余功能、结构、文档均继承上游,未作改动。

dsh-CommandCode-meter README · 源仓库与致谢：**致谢**:感谢 [Han-1413141](https://github.com/Han-1413141) 及上游 dsh-cost-meter 的所有贡献者——本项目绝大部分代码与设计都来自上游,我们只是在其基础上做了一层针对性定制。上游仓库:[Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter](https://github.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter)(MIT)。

The upstream `dsh-cost-meter` is a feature-complete **DeepSeek Harness session cost tracking plugin**: per-conversation cost, official balance query, budget box, custom provider balance, history, peak/off-peak pricing, official price sync, Coding Plan quotas, token heat grid, and more — with a built-in 90+ model price catalog and auto-matching, in a bilingual (zh/en) UI. dsh-CommandCode-meter README · Upstream & acknowledgements：**Why this fork**: we use the **Command Code GOAT** subscription (rather than OpenCode Go) day to day. The upstream Go-quota card only talks to `opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`, so it cannot query Command Code subscription quotas. This repo therefore forks the project and replaces the Go-quota card with the official Command Code endpoint `GET https://api.commandcode.ai/alpha/billing/credits` (Bearer auth), adding 5-hour / weekly / monthly-pool “used / total + progress bar” displays; credential resolution was also switched to the DSH credential store / `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` environment variable. Everything except the Go-quota card code — features, structure, docs — is inherited from upstream unchanged.

dsh-CommandCode-meter README · Upstream & acknowledgements：**Acknowledgements**: thanks to [Han-1413141](https://github.com/Han-1413141) and all contributors of upstream dsh-cost-meter — the vast majority of this project's code and design comes from upstream; we only layered a targeted customization on top. Upstream repo: [Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter](https://github.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter) (MIT).

  separator differences are absorbed by canonical matching.

prices** only overwrites the DeepSeek main table; provider tables must be checked by hand.

> After a price-table update, startup automatically re-costs historical buckets that have tokens but a
> zero amount (billed at off-peak). To re-price history precisely at its real peak/off-peak instants,
> toggling the **pricing currency** once triggers a full replay recompute.
